# Saint Kitts and Nevis — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What is the capital of Saint Kitts and Nevis?", "Basseterre"),
    ("What currency does Saint Kitts and Nevis use?", "East Caribbean Dollar"),
    ("What is capital?", "Basseterre"),
    ("What is currency?", "East Caribbean Dollar (XCD)"),
    ("What is calling code?", "+1-869"),
    ("What is internet domain?", ".kn"),
    ("What is driving side?", "left"),
    ("What is continent?", "North America"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
